# netactuate_vpc_gateway_firewall_rules (Data Source)

Reads VPC Gateway Firewall Rules visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_vpc_gateway_firewall_rules" "example" {
  ip_version = 4
  vpc_id     = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_version` (Number) IP version whose gateway firewall rules will be listed
- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID whose gateway firewall rules will be listed

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rules` (List of Object) List of gateway firewall rules attached to the VPC (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `direction` (String)
- `firewall_rule_id` (Number)
- `ip_version` (Number)
- `network` (String)
- `port_end` (Number)
- `port_start` (Number)
- `prefix_length` (Number)
- `protocol` (String)
